name: asparagine + glucose, 180 C / 4 min (the acrylamide lane)
_why: The third lane, and a deliberately uncomfortable example: the acrylamide lane's measured skill on its gating rows is 0/4, and the cutover exam found its TIME SHAPE inverted (a source measures acrylamide rising 28 -> 1459 ppb between 10 and 30 min; the core predicts it falling). The flux map is where you can see why -- look at how much material the elimination channels carry relative to formation. A picture of a model failing in a located way is more useful than no picture.
